priority.description: User defined numeric priority of the tag. Tags are fired asynchronously in order of priority. Tags with higher numeric value fire first. A tag's priority can be a positive or negative value. The default value is 0.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

monitoringMetadataTagNameKey.description: If non-empty, then the tag display name will be included in the monitoring metadata map using the key specified.

teardownTag.description: The list of teardown tags. Currently we only allow one.

paused.description: Indicates whether the tag is paused, which prevents the tag from firing.

blockingTriggerId.description: Blocking trigger IDs. If any of the listed triggers evaluate to true, the tag will not fire.

liveOnly.description: If set to true, this tag will only fire in the live environment (e.g. not in preview or debug mode).

scheduleStartMs.description: The start timestamp in milliseconds to schedule a tag.

tagId.description: The Tag ID uniquely identifies the GTM Tag.

firingTriggerId.description: Firing trigger IDs. A tag will fire when any of the listed triggers are true and all of its blockingTriggerIds (if any specified) are false.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Tag as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the tag is modified.

monitoringMetadata.description: A map of key-value pairs of tag metadata to be included in the event data for tag monitoring. Notes: - This parameter must be type MAP. - Each parameter in the map are type TEMPLATE, however cannot contain variable references.

Variable.description: Represents a Google Tag Manager Variable.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Variable as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the variable is modified.

notes.description: User notes on how to apply this variable in the container.

formatValue.description: Option to convert a variable value to other value.

scheduleEndMs.description: The end timestamp in milliseconds to schedule a variable.

variableId.description: The Variable ID uniquely identifies the GTM Variable.

disablingTriggerId.description: For mobile containers only: A list of trigger IDs for disabling conditional variables; the variable is enabled if one of the enabling trigger is true while all the disabling trigger are false. Treated as an unordered set.

enablingTriggerId.description: For mobile containers only: A list of trigger IDs for enabling conditional variables; the variable is enabled if one of the enabling triggers is true while all the disabling triggers are false. Treated as an unordered set.

scheduleStartMs.description: The start timestamp in milliseconds to schedule a variable.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the GTM Client as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the client is modified.

clientId.description: The Client ID uniquely identifies the GTM client.

notes.description: User notes on how to apply this tag in the container.

accountId.description: The Account ID uniquely identifies the GTM Account.

UserPermission.description: Represents a user's permissions to an account and its container.

supportMultipleContainers.description: Whether this Account supports multiple Containers.

supportUserPermissions.description: Whether this Account supports user permissions managed by GTM.

tagManagerUrl.description: Auto generated link to the tag manager UI

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the Google tag config as computed at storage time. This value is recomputed whenever the config is modified.

workspaceId.description: Google tag workspace ID. Only used by GTM containers. Set to 0 otherwise.

path.description: Google tag config's API relative path.

gtagConfigId.description: The ID uniquely identifies the Google tag config.

changes.description: The entities that were added or updated during the bulk-update. Does not include entities that were deleted or updated by the system.

ListEnabledBuiltInVariablesResponse.description: A list of enabled built-in variables.

builtInVariable.description: All GTM BuiltInVariables of a GTM container.

nextPageToken.description: Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

supportBuiltInVariables.description: Whether this Container supports built-in variables

supportUserPermissions.description: Whether this Container supports user permissions managed by GTM.

supportVersions.description: Whether this Container supports Container versions.

supportGtagConfigs.description: Whether this Container supports Google tag config.

tagName.description: The name of the setup tag.

stopOnSetupFailure.description: If true, fire the main tag if and only if the setup tag fires successfully. If false, fire the main tag regardless of setup tag firing status.

SetupTag.description: Represents a reference to atag that fires before another tag in order to set up dependencies.

GalleryReference.description: Represents the link between a custom template and an entry on the Community Template Gallery site.

host.description: The name of the host for the community gallery template.

signature.description: The signature of the community gallery template as computed at import time. This value is recomputed whenever the template is updated from the gallery.

repository.description: The name of the repository for the community gallery template.

owner.description: The name of the owner for the community gallery template.

templateDeveloperId.description: The developer id of the community gallery template. This value is set whenever the template is created from the gallery.

version.description: The version of the community gallery template.

galleryTemplateId.description: ID for the gallery template that is generated once during first sync and travels with the template redirects.

isModified.description: If a user has manually edited the community gallery template.

folder.description: Folder as it appears in the latest container version since the last workspace synchronization operation. If no folder is present, that means the folder was deleted in the latest container version.

RevertFolderResponse.description: The result of reverting folder changes in a workspace.

tag.description: The list of tags inside the folder.

trigger.description: The list of triggers inside the folder.

variable.description: The list of variables inside the folder.

nextPageToken.description: Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

FolderEntities.description: Represents a Google Tag Manager Folder's contents.

GetWorkspaceStatusResponse.description: The changes that have occurred in the workspace since the base container version.

workspaceChange.description: Entities that have been changed in the workspace.

nextPageToken.description: Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

workspace.description: All Workspaces of a GTM Container.

ListWorkspacesResponse.description: A list of workspaces in a container.

nickname.description: The zone's nickname for the child container.

ZoneChildContainer.description: Represents a child container of a Zone.

consentStatus.description: The tag's consent status. If set to NEEDED, the runtime will check that the consent types specified by the consent_type field have been granted.
enumDescriptions: Default value where user has not specified any setting on it.
Tag doesn't require any additional consent settings.

consentType.description: The type of consents to check for during tag firing if in the consent NEEDED state. This parameter must be of type LIST where each list item is of type STRING.

zone.description: Zone as it appears in the latest container version since the last workspace synchronization operation. If no zone is present, that means the zone was deleted in the latest container version.

RevertZoneResponse.description: The result of reverting a zone in a workspace.

name.description: Name of the built-in variable to be used to refer to the built-in variable.

BuiltInVariable.description: Built-in variables are a special category of variables that are pre-created and non-customizable. They provide common functionality like accessing properties of the gtm data layer, monitoring clicks, or accessing elements of a page URL.
